page.layout: One blank page of pasted paper, with only handwritten pencil and ink annotations and an faint seal impression; no printed text.
page.notes: The page is blank apart from manuscript annotations, which are not printed text and are therefore not transcribed: "Fol. 2221" in ink at upper right, "1585" in pencil at centre, "Kat. 6.79 vi" in pencil at lower left, and "570 a (f. 66.)" with "14 a (f. 66.)" and "gel. 7." in pencil at lower right. A faint circular seal or stamp impression lies below the 1585. The edges show book boards and endpaper, not text.
